interventions.title: Vegetated Buffer Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Infill
interventions.description: Construct a sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a continuous and safe pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential area.

interventions.title: Vegetation Maintenance
interventions.description: Regularly trim trees and bushes to ensure they do not encroach on the sidewalk or block sightlines.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install user-actuated amber LEDs to supplement warning signs at the uncontrolled crossing to increase driver yielding rates.

interventions.title: Driveway Design Standards
interventions.description: Ensure driveways maintain the sidewalk level and material to reinforce pedestrian priority and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Add center line or edge line markings to better define the travel lanes and organize vehicle movement.

interventions.title: Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps at the corner to ensure accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove corner vegetation to improve sightlines between all road users.
